title: Installation Jobs: Factory Delay Notices and Company Reschedule Credits
content:
**Factory delay notices and the company reschedule credit — Installation Jobs**

The factory-delay adder on a company reschedule credit for an **Installation Jobs** record follows the delay notices recorded on the **Factory Production Orders** order the job installs, and it is added to the credit:

| Delay notices recorded on the factory order the job installs | Factory-delay adder |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | $30.00 |
| exactly one | $15.00 |
| none | nothing |

Only delay notices recorded on that factory order count; other checkpoints of the order, and the orders of other jobs, do not.

## Cases (hypothetical factory orders)

- A factory order with three delay notices on record: $30.00.
- A factory order with a single delay notice: $15.00.
- A factory order with checkpoints and no delay notice: nothing.
